# The ensembl feed

Ensembl gene annotations of a gene panel.

Gene annotations of a small gene panel (default BRCA1, BRCA2 and TP53) from the Ensembl REST API, GRCh38: chromosome, start, end, strand, biotype and the protein length of the canonical transcript, as rows of the genomics module's gene kind.

| | |
|---|---|
| Source | Ensembl (EMBL-EBI) (https://www.ensembl.org) |
| Licence | [Ensembl data is open (EMBL-EBI terms of use)](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/about/terms-of-use/): redistributable with attribution |
| Attribution | Contains data from Ensembl (EMBL-EBI), https://www.ensembl.org |
| Notes | Free to use and redistribute; the REST API allows 15 requests a second and the feed asks for about 5. |
| Lake | `genomicslake` (load route `java`) |
| Schedule | daily at 06:10 (local time) |
| Pull | `ensembl.EnsemblFeed` (tools/loaders/genomics/ensembl.py); 0.2 s between requests, 3 retries |

## Run it

```bash
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run ensembl --dry-run      # what it would fetch and load; changes nothing
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run ensembl                # pull today, write data/datafeeds/ensembl/<date>/, load into genomicslake
python3 tools/drishti.py feed status ensembl             # its last runs
```

Daily: `python3 tools/drishti.py feed schedule --cron` (or `--systemd`, `--windows`). The guide: [WORLD_DATA_GUIDE.md](../../docs/guides/WORLD_DATA_GUIDE.md).

## Data contract

### gene

Pack `genomics`, kind `gene`, table `gene`, key `GENE`; files `data/datafeeds/ensembl/<date>/gene.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the run's business date.

One gene of the panel: chromosome, start, end, strand, biotype, protein length of the canonical transcript.

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GENE` | string |  | the HGNC symbol |
| `CHROM` | string |  |  |
| `START` | integer |  |  |
| `PROTEIN_LENGTH` | integer |  | amino acids (the lollipop's axis) |
| `DOMAINS` | list |  | protein domains: NAME, FROM, TO |
| `VARIANTS` | integer |  |  |

The contract: `modules/genomics/packs/genomics/contracts/gene.yaml`
